raw_response:
I've been farming these three mu for 18 years now. My husband works construction in the city most of the year, and my daughter is in high school, so it's mostly me and my mother-in-law handling the field work. We don't hire labor — for three mu we manage ourselves, though it's busy during harvest.

I have two mu that I do wheat-maize double cropping on, and one mu for cotton. The wheat needs to go in now, early October. I buy improved wheat seed from the agricultural supply store — about 35 yuan per mu. I don't get the most expensive hybrid seeds; for my small plot, it's not worth it.

The extension technician told me I should use 15 kg of nitrogen per mu for wheat, but fertilizer got more expensive again this year and I only have about 1,300 yuan total for all inputs. So I'm cutting back a bit to 12 kg N per mu for wheat. I'll put down compound fertilizer as a base before planting — about 40 kg per mu — and then topdress with urea at jointing if the wheat looks yellow. That way I can wait and see before spending more. It's a tradeoff: I might lose a little yield, but I need to keep some cash for emergencies. My neighbor Lao Wang uses about the same amount on his small plot, and he does fine.

For irrigation, wheat needs water, and our well water costs money. I'll irrigate three times: once before winter, once in spring when it greens up, and once at heading if there's no rain. That's already about 140 yuan just for wheat water. For maize in summer, I'll do two irrigations.

The maize planting is always the hardest part — after we harvest wheat in early June, I have maybe a week to get the maize in the ground. I use hybrid maize seed, about 42 yuan per mu. I put all the fertilizer down at planting because there's no time for split application in that rush. About 14 kg N per mu as compound plus some urea. Maize usually gives me better yields than wheat, around 420 kg per mu.

My cotton is on the one mu plot. I plant in mid-April. Cotton needs a lot of hand-picking, which is why I only keep one mu of it — any more and I couldn't manage the labor. I fertilize twice: base at planting and topdress at flowering. Around 10 kg N per mu. I irrigate twice and spray for pests when I see them. I expect about 250 kg of seed cotton per mu.

Total cost will be around 1,300 yuan. It's a lot for us, but if I cut too much on fertilizer and the yield drops, we lose more than we save. I'd rather be a bit conservative and make sure we have enough to eat and some to sell.
